app_stall_ms.definition: longest gap between consecutive echo arrivals in the window [handoff start - 250 ms, handoff end + 250 ms], mean over the run's handoffs (Stage 3 'max_interarrival_gap_in_window_ms'). Nominal probe spacing is 1000/rate_pps ms, so a no-stall value is that spacing.

handoff_latency_ms.definition: time from the handoff start to the approach's OWN recovery point (registration reply, binding update, first data on the new connection...). The recovery point differs per approach, so this is not compared across approaches.

handoff_loss_packets.definition: probes in the loss burst overlapping each handoff window, summed over the run's handoffs.

handoffs_unrecovered.definition: handoffs that never reached the approach's recovery point before the run ended.

interruption_ms.definition: Stage 3 loss-burst interruption (time between the last echo before and the first after a loss burst); defined ONLY for handoffs where a probe-loss burst overlaps the window, so reliable transports (no probe loss) have no value. Mean over the run's handoffs that have one.

loss_percent.definition: probes sent but never echoed, as a percentage of probes sent (whole run). Reliable transports (TCP, QUIC) retransmit, so their loss shows up as delay/stall instead: compare loss only within one transport class.

mobility_overhead_bytes_per_packet.definition: extra header bytes the approach adds to each data packet. Counted from byte-accurate simulated packets; 'derived' when the run's overhead basis says analytic.

path_stretch.definition: rtt_after_ms divided by the DIRECT-path RTT to the new access network. Numerator observed; denominator DERIVED from the run's effective link delays (2 x (cn-AN + AN-mn)). 1.0 = as short as the direct path; >1 = detour via the Home Agent or retransmission delay.

rtt_after_ms.definition: median RTT of the first 10 echoes after the handoff window (Stage 3), mean over the run's handoffs.

signalling_messages_per_handoff.definition: mobility/transport signalling messages the mobile node sent or received between handoff start and recovery (approach_events.csv).
